failure_detail.root_cause: The strict-schema projection (_provider_schema) adds every property to 'required' and makes non-required fields nullable via _nullable_schema. The provider therefore legally emitted physical_entity: null for an ungrounded actor. The canonical parser (MissionActor.from_json via _text) rejects null because it requires a nonblank string. Schema and parser disagree on optional-field nullability: offline tests use hand-written fixtures without the key, so this only surfaces at the real provider boundary.

classification_note: The provider did NOT reject the schema (no 400/422): the strict-schema acceptance gate itself PASSED. The failure is downstream: the v0.8 strict projection is more permissive (nullable) than the canonical parser (nonblank string). Classified as FAIL_CONTRACT because the provider-facing contract and the canonical validation are semantically inconsistent — exactly the class of bug offline DTO tests cannot catch.
